needed.evidence: No zebra crossing visible despite pedestrian demand at the intersection.
needed.suggestion: Install marked zebra crossings at this intersection to ensure safe pedestrian crossings.

needed.evidence: Obstacles such as parked vehicles and other objects partially blocking the sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Clear and maintain a continuous, unobstructed sidewalk on the right side by enforcing parking regulations.

needed.evidence: Obstacles reduce the usability of the narrow footway.
needed.suggestion: Widen the left footway and install physical barriers to separate pedestrian and vehicular paths.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the narrow footway pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and resurface trip hazards on the left footway to ensure a safe pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: Uneven or broken sections on the sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Repair uneven and broken sections on the right footway to improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs visible at the crossing point.
needed.suggestion: Implement kerb ramps at the crossing points to provide accessibility for pedestrians, especially those with limited mobility.
